title: CTSwap
tagline: An decenteralized exchange with one asset pair(will add more on in future work). ETH/ CD Token
description:
An decenteralized exchange with one asset pair(will add more on in future work). ETH/ CD Token, the  exchange takes a fee of 1% on swaps.
When the user adds liquidity, they will be given Crypto Dev LP tokens (Liquidity Provider tokens).
The "CD LP" tokens will be given proportional to the Ether user is willing to add to the liquidity.
how_its_made:
This project uses Filecoin Virtual Machine(FVM) as a deployer which not only solves speed and time issue but also gives extra momentum ie. FVM provides Storage and speed which makes the tooling smooth and easy to use.
We just used Filecoin as our sponsor technology because it gives us our needy ie. storage which makes the process faster and reliable.
